subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a core public session-discussion provider API now, and if so, what agent-qualified session identity and plugin lifecycle guarantees must that API provide?
rationale: The branch introduces a new public plugin SDK module and gateway protocol rather than repairing an established behavior; the durable API boundary cannot be chosen safely by automated review.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core seam
options.body: Approve the generic seam after it carries canonical agent-qualified identity and loader-managed provider registration.

options.title: Keep it provider-owned for now
options.body: Defer the core API and let the ClickClack integration prove the required contract in its plugin before standardizing a shared seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded core seam
recommendation.body: Approve the generic seam after it carries canonical agent-qualified identity and loader-managed provider registration.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete authored the proposed public interface and its integration rationale.
